title: 7 Days in Japan: Tokyo, Kyoto & Osaka — Complete Travel Guide 2024
description:
Join me on my week-long trip through Japan! Starting in Tokyo with the iconic Shibuya Crossing and Senso-ji Temple, then heading to Kyoto to walk through thousands of torii gates at Fushimi Inari. We also explore the stunning Arashiyama Bamboo Grove before finishing in Osaka for incredible street food at Dotonbori.

📍 Places visited:
- Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo
- Senso-ji Temple, Asakusa
- teamLab Planets, Tokyo
- Shinjuku Gyoen Garden
- Fushimi Inari Taisha, Kyoto
- Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
- Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
- Nishiki Market, Kyoto
- Dotonbori, Osaka
- Kuromon Ichiba Market
